risks.risk: Brakes may be weak/dragging or rotors may be warped—photo only shows rotors, not braking performance.
risks.proof: Video clip of a safe test: hard stop from moderate speed + close-up of both brake calipers/rotors while braking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bicycle with unknown brake performance (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Gears/shifting may skip or not index correctly—photo doesn’t show drivetrain condition or shifter behavior.
risks.proof: Short video showing shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear), plus a close-up of the rear derailleur and cassette/freewheel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bicycle with unverified shifting (worst case: may need adjustment/parts).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/rim trueness and tire condition may be poor—photo can’t confirm wobble or tread depth.
risks.proof: Photo/video of wheels spun (side view) showing any wobble; close-up of tire tread and sidewall condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing possible tire/rim check (worst case: tires worn).

risks.risk: Hidden frame issues (bent hinge, cracks, rust) not visible from this single shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the folding hinge area, bottom bracket, and head tube from multiple angles (both sides).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown frame integrity (worst case: may require repair).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incorrect size/fit—photo doesn’t confirm rider size suitability.
risks.proof: Photo of the full bike with a tape measure: seat tube length and top tube length; also show any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used bike without confirmed fit (worst case: may not suit buyer).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the folding hinge area, bottom bracket, and head tube (both sides).
Send a video test: braking hard from moderate speed + show both brake rotors/calipers during the stop.
Send a video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear).
Send close-ups of drivetrain wear: chain, cassette/freewheel, chainrings, and rear derailleur.
Send wheel-spin video (side view) to check wobble + close-ups of tire tread.
response.reason: From photo 0 the bike type is visible, but key condition factors that determine price in Lagos (brakes, shifting, wheel alignment, drivetrain wear, and frame integrity) are not verifiable from a single image, so a worst-case price would be unreliable without proof.
